title: Env Guard Script
description: Fail fast when required env vars are missing.
code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

required=(API_URL API_KEY)
for var in "${required[@]}"; do
  if [[ -z "${!var:-}" ]]; then
    echo "Missing env: $var" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
done
author: ShellPilot
